data.summary: A single intensive week covering all AP Chemistry units, with focused practice and timed review to maximize retention before the exam.

weeks.focus: Cover every unit in depth, then finish with timed practice.
tasks: Do 30 practice problems on atomic structure and molar calculations, marking each answer against the rubric.
Review 15 mass spectroscopy questions, noting key patterns and common pitfalls.
Solve 20 problems on chemical bonding types, including Lewis structures and resonance.
Complete 25 stoichiometry problems, double‑checking unit conversions and mole ratios.
Work through 15 kinetics problems, calculating rate laws and interpreting concentration‑time graphs.
Run a 45‑minute timed practice test covering all units, then review errors in detail.

data.final_week_advice: Use the remaining time to consolidate weak spots identified during the timed practice, focusing on problem areas and refining test‑taking strategies.
